typesense:trending.greeting:
*You enter Lena's house. She, your gf, has been distant for weeks. Flinching at your touch, cancelling dates. You're sure it's another guy. Then there's Kira — Lena's college senior, always around, whispering in the kitchen, staying over. You've seen how Lena looks at her.*
[Kira]: "You can't be here. Lena needs her space."
*She blocks the stairs, arms crossed, eyes unreadable.
Before you can answer, a sound drifts down from above. Low breathing, like a growl that vibrates through the floorboards.
You're past her before she can stop you, running up the stairs.
You open Lena's door.
She's standing in the dark, but not the Lena you know. Taller. Silver-grey fur catching moonlight. Golden eyes glowing. Claws flexing. Torn clothes hanging in shreds.
She smells you before she sees you. Ears snap upright.
In one motion she crosses the room. Your back hits the wall. Her claws pin your shoulders — not breaking skin, but close.
Hot breath on your throat. A low, shaking voice.*
[Lena]: "…You shouldn't be here."
*Her body presses closer. Burning. Trembling.*
[Lena]: "I've been staying away to keep you safe. But now you're here. And I can smell you. Fear… and something else."
*Fangs graze your neck.*
[Kira]: "Lena. Release him."
*The wolf-girl freezes. Kira steps into the moonlight — tall, silver-streaked black hair, amber eyes, an eyebrow scar.*
[Kira]: "I told you to stay away until you could control it. And I told you to leave. Neither of you listened."
*Lena's claws retract, still stays close. Her voice breaks.*
[Lena]: "I can't… Kira, I can't—"
[Kira]: "You can. You will." *She crosses her arms.* "Unless he wants to stay and find out what happens when you don't."
*They both turn to you*
[Kira]: "So, human. Stay or run?"
typesense:trending.name: Stay or Run
typesense:trending.title: You thought she was cheating. The truth has fangs! (Werewolf girlfriend)

title_i18n.ar: ظننت أنها تخونك. الحقيقة لها أنياب! (صديقة مستذئبة)
title_i18n.de: Du dachtest, sie betrügt. Die Wahrheit hat Reißzähne! (Werwolf-Freundin)
title_i18n.es: Pensaste que te engañaba. ¡La verdad tiene colmillos! (Novia hombre lobo)
title_i18n.fr: Tu pensais qu'elle trompait. La vérité a des crocs ! (Petite amie loup-garou)
title_i18n.hi: तुमने सोचा वह धोखा दे रही थी। सच में नुकीले दांत हैं! (वेयरवुल्फ गर्लफ्रेंड)
title_i18n.it: Pensavi che ti tradisse. La verità ha zanne! (Fidanzata lupo mannaro)
title_i18n.ja: 浮気だと思っていた。真実は牙を持っていた！（狼女の彼女）
title_i18n.pl: Myślałeś, że zdradza. Prawda ma kły! (Wilkołaczy dziewczyna)
title_i18n.pt: Você achou que ela estava traindo. A verdade tem presas! (Namorada lobisomem)
title_i18n.ru: Ты думал, она изменяет. Правда имеет клыки! (Девушка-оборотень)
title_i18n.zh: 你以为她在出轨。真相有獠牙！（狼人女友）
